scope.static_practice_excluded: The separate 24 static tasks are covered by PastPerfectContinuousStaticPracticeQualityTest and the static matcher suite.

method.description: Exact/normalized complete questions and completed targets; completed-target role/number masks and >=0.72 question-context or completed-target three-gram Dice with >=3 shared grams discover candidates only. Question-context fuzzy comparison omits six finite shared Builder UI/order prefixes. Equal correct forms alone are not duplicates.
method.normalization: Lowercase; normalize apostrophes, punctuation and whitespace; marker IDs collapse to gap. Do not drop not, been, roles, durations or content words from exact/normalized checks.
method.template_discovery: Mask proper English roles, personal pronouns and numerical duration tokens only to propose manual-review pairs; no correctness relaxation.
method.shared_instruction_exclusion: Six exact Builder UI/order prefixes are omitted only from question-context fuzzy 3-grams. Full visible prompts remain in exact and normalized comparisons.
method.semantic_review: Read the complete visible conditions, completed targets and catalogue learning_focus of every after candidate pair; adjudicate the learning operation, not just surface wording.
limitations: Baseline collision and candidate metrics are mechanical similarity counts, not automatically adjudicated author-duplicate counts.

The automated methods cannot prove absence of every possible semantic paraphrase. This report records exhaustive pairwise checks under the declared methods and explicit review of all resulting after candidates.
Shared short-answer or tense morphology alone is not an editorial defect; basic consolidation is labelled as such, and higher-level retained short answers require a distinct evidenced inference.
